2687.title: Plugin discovery timeout message
2687.rootCauseOneLine: The CLI exits after a read-only discovery timeout and before it sends the plugin command request.
2687.proposedFix: Do not change the message from this evidence. Correlate historical CLI processes with server request logs to find the duplicate-write path.
2687.caveats: The historical process and server request logs were not available. The report verifies the current main-branch control flow.
